Package neqsim.util.serialization

Class NeqSimXtream.NeqSimObjectConverter

java.lang.Object
com.thoughtworks.xstream.converters.reflection.AbstractReflectionConverter
com.thoughtworks.xstream.converters.reflection.ReflectionConverter
neqsim.util.serialization.NeqSimXtream.NeqSimObjectConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.thoughtworks.xstream.converters.Converter, com.thoughtworks.xstream.converters.ConverterMatcher, com.thoughtworks.xstream.core.Caching
Enclosing class:
NeqSimXtream
private static class NeqSimXtream.NeqSimObjectConverter extends com.thoughtworks.xstream.converters.reflection.ReflectionConverter
Converter for NeqSim classes. Writes exactly as the default XStream converters do (custom layout for classes with readObject/writeObject, plain field layout otherwise) and reads both layouts. For legacy files it restores the initial value of every field missing from the XML and runs private readObject hooks.

    • restoringReader

      private com.thoughtworks.xstream.io.HierarchicalStreamReader restoringReader(com.thoughtworks.xstream.io.HierarchicalStreamReader reader, Object result)
      Restores each custom default block before defaultReadObject returns to the class's hook. This preserves any dependent values calculated by that hook and avoids invoking a custom readObject twice.
      Parameters:
      reader - the original reader, positioned at the custom object
      result - the object being populated
      Returns:
      a reader that observes only this object's class and default-block boundaries

    • restoreMissingFields

      private Object restoreMissingFields(Object result, Set<String> written, Class<?> declaringClass)
      Restores the declared initial value of fields that were not present in the XML, taking them from a freshly constructed template instance of the same class.
      Parameters:
      result - the unmarshalled object
      written - field keys already populated or restored; newly considered fields are added to avoid overwriting hook repairs during the final pass
      declaringClass - the class whose default block just ended, or null for the final pass
      Returns:
      the constructor template, or null if none was needed or could be constructed

      Returns:

    • runReadObjectHooks

      private void runReadObjectHooks(Object result)
      Runs the private readObject hooks of the class hierarchy, superclass first, with a no-op object input stream so that post-deserialization repairs apply to objects read from the legacy plain layout.
      Parameters:
      result - the unmarshalled object
      Throws:
      com.thoughtworks.xstream.converters.ConversionException - if a hook rejects the loaded state or cannot complete
